observations.statement: C012 applies twelve reusable attack protocols to every one of the ninety-three live hypotheses, producing 1,116 logical attack cells with no terminal hypothesis omitted or included by mistake.

A breadth-first standardized sweep did not produce a new decisive contradiction: seventy-three hypotheses cleared all twelve protocols, ten remained under explicit pressure, and ten belong to unresolved mutually incompatible pairs.
H001-H004 remain circular as independent mechanisms because their unrestricted polynomial transformers may first decide SAT and then emit a trivial target representation.
observations.support: C012 protocol X002 and the existing claim boundaries of H001-H004.

observations.statement: Bounded-radius locality alone does not establish nonuniversality: a fixed local rule system may implement global computation across many sequential steps, so H009 remains weakened until a stronger structural restriction is stated.
observations.support: C012 protocol X002 and prior attacks on H009.

observations.statement: H017 and H019 survive only as pressured routes: H017 still lacks a proved mixed residual family after affine elimination, while H019 still needs an interface language that cannot hide an arbitrary global function.

The theta branch remains alive but narrowed: H070 needs a genuinely new gap-producing compiler, H081 still needs conditioned short-certificate existence, and H089's ordinary Gram language is superseded by the rational LDL route H092.
observations.support: C012 overrides for H070, H081, and H089 together with C011.

observations.statement: Simultaneous OPEN status is not joint evidence for mutually incompatible hypotheses; C012 explicitly records five unresolved pairs whose members cannot both be true.
observations.support: C012 protocol X011 and the pairs H006/H011, H007/H014, H012/H013, H022/H023, and H024/H025.
